title: Custom American Football on Cosmic Background Vintage Comforter
description:
Transform your space into the ultimate sports sanctuary with the Custom Vintage Galaxy Football Comforter by Jeminise. This custom-made bedding set is designed specifically for football lovers, players, and fans who want to bring the excitement of the game into their room decor. Featuring a stunning vintage galaxy football theme, this comforter offers a perfect blend of style, lightweight warmth, and personalized comfort.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features customizable text inputs allowing you to personalize the bedding with your chosen name and number.
  • Premium Material: Crafted from 100% brushed polyester fabric with a soft, whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • Sporty Visual Theme: Decorated with a vibrant digital graphic illustration of an American football on a cosmic nebula and star background.
  • Available Bedding Sizes: Designed to fit various bed setups including US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Included Components: The package comes with 1 Comforter (or Duvet Cover) and optional matching pillowcases depending on your selection.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water on a gentle cycle; tumble dry on low heat for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Vintage Galaxy Football
Theme Football
Style Contemporary
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine wash with cold water, Tumble dry on low heat, Iron on low/medium heat
